title: Myriad Horizons
description: Explore, build, and conquer in Myriad Horizons — a 1.21.1 kitchen sink pack featuring 175+ mods. From powerful machinery and magic to immersive farming, structures, and creatures, the pack offers freedom to play your way.
body:
🌌 Myriad Horizons

Minecraft Version: 1.21.1
Pack Type: Adventure / Kitchen Sink
Made for: The Myriad Horizons private SMP

Overview

Embark on a limitless journey across Myriad Horizons, a kitchen sink–style adventure modpack built for Minecraft 1.21.1 and crafted for the private SMP of the same name.

This pack blends exploration, technology, and creativity into one expansive experience. Whether you want to dive into dungeons, build sprawling factories, or master spellcraft, Myriad Horizons gives you the tools to play your way.

Features
⚙️ Create & Addons

Engineer complex factories, contraptions, and automation with Create and its many expansion mods.

✨ Magic Systems

Harness spellcraft with Ars Nouveau and magical add-ons, unlocking powerful spells and rituals.

🍲 Farming & Cooking

Enjoy immersive cooking and farming through Farmer’s Delight and its companion expansions.

🏰 Exploration & Adventure

Discover new dungeons, structures, and dimensions with YUNG’s Better series, Deeper & Darker, and more.

🗺️ Utility & Performance

Quality-of-life improvements like Inventory Profiles Next, BetterF3, Xaero’s Maps, plus optimizations from Sodium, FerriteCore, Lithium, and ModernFix keep gameplay smooth.

🐉 Creatures & Atmosphere

Face mythical beasts, tame new pets, and immerse yourself in enhanced visuals, sounds, and environments.

Why Play

With 175+ carefully curated mods, Myriad Horizons offers total freedom:

Build sprawling factories

Explore dangerous ruins

Master powerful magic

Thrive in a rich survival sandbox

💡 Play it your way — whether your focus is adventure or creativity, this pack provides endless horizons to explore with friends on the SMP.
